subject: Next steps: Marketplace evidence triage for Acme Cloud listing
messages:
From: AWS Marketplace Review <aws-marketplace-review@amazon.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Redwood listing - evidence requirements for Acme Cloud co-sell

Grace,

Thanks for submitting the initial listing request for Redwood on AWS Marketplace tied to Acme Cloud's co-sell opportunity. Before we can progress to co-sell enablement and review the listing tiles, we need the following security/compliance artifacts from the seller (Redwood):

- SOC 2 Type II report (most recent 12-month period) or SOC 2 bridge letter if report is in flight
- Penetration test attestation (summary letter from an independent vendor; full report optional)
- Data Processing Addendum (signed or a tracked redline + timeline to complete)
- Evidence index (mapping of controls to artifacts)

Please upload the items to the AWS Seller Portal or share a secure Drive link. For co-sell specifically we need the SOC 2 and pen-test attestation by next Thursday (2026-12-17) to keep the Acme listing on schedule.

If you have any questions about the exact scope or acceptable formats, let me know.

Regards,
Rachel Thompson
AWS Marketplace Review
aws-marketplace-review@amazon.com

---
Attachments: none
From: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
Cc: AWS Marketplace Review <aws-marketplace-review@amazon.com>, Acme Cloud - Marketplace Ops <marketplace@acme.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Dec 2026 10:05:00 -08:00
Subject: RE: Redwood listing - evidence requirements for Acme Cloud co-sell

Folks,

Forwarding AWS' list — Acme is pushing to get on the co-sell path by the end of the month. Quick triage: who owns what and what can we reasonably deliver by 2026-12-17?

My initial break down:
- SOC2 report: we have the final 2024 SOC2 Type II (Tabled but redacted copy available) — Dev, can you confirm the folder & redaction notes?
- Pen test attestation: security completed a vendor attestation earlier this year; I believe Dev has the attestation letter.
- DPA: legal has an Acme negotiated DPA in progress — Lauren, status and ETA?
- Evidence index: I'll draft the mapping once we confirm artifacts.

Action items (please reply inline):
Sergio — coordinate the upload to AWS and confirm whether we need AWS-specific packaging (they asked for portal upload or Drive link).
Dev — send SOC2 redacted PDF and the pen-test attestation; include the control mapping stub you maintain.
Lauren — send the DPA redline or executed copy; if not executed, provide the expected sign date and any outstanding clauses that might block co-sell.

I will assemble the evidence_index_sheet.xlsx and share a Drive folder. Copying AWS & Acme so they see we're moving.

Thanks,
Grace
Head of Marketplace & Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Grace / Sergio —

I pulled the artifacts this morning. Status: 
- redwood_SOC2_typeII_2024.pdf (redacted): available and attached for portal upload. Redactions: service-specific customer data removed; cover page and principal auditor signature retained.
- pen_test_attestation_redwood_2026.txt: summary attestation from our vendor (ThirdWall Security) confirming no critical findings; full report is under NDA and can be shared with an SSO-protected link if AWS requests it.

I've placed both files into the shared Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcDefExAmPlE-evidence-pack (view restricted to invited reviewers).

Mapping notes (brief): SOC2 controls a subset of what AWS asks; see evidence_index_sheet.xlsx I started — will finish mapping to AWS requested control IDs today.

Attachments: redwood_SOC2_typeII_2024.pdf (attachment), pen_test_attestation_redwood_2026.txt (attachment)

- Dev
Security & Infrastructure

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>
Cc: legal@acme.com, AWS Marketplace Review <aws-marketplace-review@amazon.com>
Date: Thu, 17 Dec 2026 11:22:00 -08:00
Subject: RE: Redwood listing - evidence requirements for Acme Cloud co-sell

Grace —

DPA status: Acme returned a redline yesterday. I reviewed their key asks (data residency clause tweak, expanded breach notification timing, and audit right window). I attached the executed copy that we have with other partners (redwood_dpa_executed_acme.pdf) as a template; the Acme redline is in comments in the Drive folder.

Quick notes: 
- We should be able to accept their redline except for the audit depth clause; proposing we offer a scoped audit with our SOC2 attestation and an on-site audit only for material incidents. I'll draft suggested language and propose a 7-day turn for signature if Acme accepts the scoped audit language.
- If Acme insists on a broader audit right, we may need legal escalation (I can loop commercial legal counsel).

I'll drop a redline version in Drive and tag Acme legal.

Lauren Bishop
Senior Counsel, Commercial
Redwood Inference
---

Hi Rachel / Acme team —

Thanks for the timeline. Per AWS' request, we've consolidated the evidence and placed it in a secure folder. Summary of what we're providing now: 

- redwood_SOC2_typeII_2024.pdf (redacted copy) — covers relevant controls for marketplace listing
- pen_test_attestation_redwood_2026.txt — vendor attestation confirming no critical findings; full report available under NDA on request
- redwood_dpa_executed_acme.pdf and Acme redline (in Drive) — legal is pushing to a scoped audit solution and expects signature within 7 business days if accepted
- evidence_index_sheet.xlsx — control mapping (SOC2 sections -> marketplace checklist)

Drive link (view access granted to AWS & Acme): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcDefExAmPlE-evidence-pack
DocuSign: we'll execute the final DPA via DocuSign and I will update this thread once signed.

Sergio will trigger the AWS Seller Portal upload this afternoon. If AWS needs the full pen-test report before review, please let us know and we will arrange a secured transfer under NDA.

Next steps / owners: 
- Sergio: upload to AWS Seller Portal and confirm receipt (owner: sergio_alvarez)
- Lauren: finalize DPA language with Acme legal (owner: lauren_bishop)
- Dev: anything else missing from the index (owner: dev_patel)
- Grace: follow up with Acme and AWS on co-sell timeline

Thanks —
Grace
